# Cam Leinad

> Cam Leinad is an independent pop and easy-listening artist releasing on Cam All May (CAM), his independent record label. Born in Uganda on 16 May 2004; lived in the UK and South Korea. Debut single "How It Starts" released April 18, 2026. Upcoming EP "Distant Light" (6 tracks).

## Artist

- **Brand:** CAM
- **Record label:** Cam All May (short form: CAM)
- **Label:** Independent, founded by Cam Leinad; no major-label affiliation
- **Name origin:** Cam Leinad is "Daniel Mac" reversed; CAM is the short form and also the Cam All May label name. "May" refers to the artist's birth month. Three names, one identity: born Daniel Mac, becoming Cam Leinad, releasing under Cam All May.
- **Artist name:** Cam Leinad
- **Genre:** Pop, Easy Listening
- **Tagline:** Pop. Easy Listening.
- **Label tagline:** Released independently on Cam All May.
- **Origin:** Uganda
- **Started:** 2026
- **Contact:** camleinad@outlook.com

## Released Music

- How It Starts — Single — April 18, 2026 — Released on Cam All May (CAM)
